agentPrompts.label: Show me the message house
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-brand` skill in this folder, then show me the message house: the canonical or draft positioning statement, the value pillars, the overall Narrative Quality Score with its gate, and the open drift-alert count.

agentPrompts.label: Walk me through what needs review
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-brand` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then walk me through the narrative items and drift alerts awaiting a decision one at a time, and record the verdict I give for each. Never adopt or export an asset without an explicit approve verdict.
